plugins.prepareCmd: echo ${nextRelease.version} > version.txt && curl -L -o kubebuilder "https://go.kubebuilder.io/dl/latest/$(go env GOOS)/$(go env GOARCH)" && chmod +x kubebuilder && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && mv kubebuilder ~/.local/bin/ && curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash && make build-installer IMG=ghcr.io/ctfpilot/flight-ops-groundcontrol:${nextRelease.version} && ~/.local/bin/kubebuilder edit --plugins=helm/v1-alpha && sed -i "s/^version: .*/version: ${nextRelease.version}/" dist/chart/Chart.yaml && sed -i "s/^appVersion: .*/appVersion: \"${nextRelease.version}\"/" dist/chart/Chart.yaml && sed -i "s/      tag: .*/      tag: ${nextRelease.version}/" dist/chart/values.yaml && sed -i "s/^version: .*/version: ${nextRelease.version}/" dist/dispatcher/chart/Chart.yaml && sed -i "s/^appVersion: .*/appVersion: \"${nextRelease.version}\"/" dist/dispatcher/chart/Chart.yaml && sed -i "s/    tag: .*/    tag: ${nextRelease.version}/" dist/dispatcher/chart/values.yaml && rm -rf release-assets && mkdir -p release-assets && helm package dist/chart -d release-assets && helm package dist/dispatcher/chart -d release-assets
